name: fix161_forced_release
verifies: fix-161 [owner] port option 'Freeing by force counts' (default on): the hero kills Potros while Gorn_FreeHim runs -> the quest is won (Success, its 1500 XP and Reb fame) instead of G3's Failed, Potros_DefeatHim still counts the kill, Gorn says 'You're free now' (BPANKRATZ31196) as after the bribe; Gorn's cell News closes Gorn_ShowReddock while still Open -> Obsolete, which G3's quest log lists on no tab. Then with the option off a failed release (save from before) is re-judged when it comes on.
steps: safe fame=0; god; notips; time 12; forcedrelease on=1
flag Gorn_GothaPrison; flag Potros_HisDuties; flag Potros_GornWillBePunished; quest Gorn_FreeHim Running
log -- option on: the hero kills Potros -> Gorn_FreeHim Success
log -- option off (G3): the same kill fails the quest, switching the option on re-judges it
log -- a kill by someone else (not the hero party) stays G3: Failed
notes: Lars_FreeHim (Zapotek, deal BPANKRATZ3267) is the pack's other release quest; covered headless in ForcedReleaseTests (Lars_InNot cleared so CP's NEWM0061 does not free him a second time). fix-166 (b1019d FAIL 'Gorn_FreeHim=Success: was Failed'): the scenario's 'kill Potros' had no killer=hero, so the death was nobody's (ActorDefeated.ByPlayerParty false) and the option rightly left G3's Failed; the kill is now the hero's, plus the option-off/re-judge part and a non-party kill.
